metadata.description: Jon Gallant's collection of cross-agent skills for AI coding agents — GitHub Copilot, Claude, and Codex.

plugins.name: jongio-skills
plugins.description: Install the complete Jon Gallant skills collection as one plugin.

plugins.name: create-canvas-app
plugins.description: Build GitHub Copilot canvas extensions fast — a no-build Preact + htm kit with live SSE state, durable storage, Primer theming, official GitHub Lucide icons, a generator, and tests.

plugins.name: create-gh-pages-site
plugins.description: Scaffold a working GitHub Pages site from a vetted template (static, Astro, React + Vite, Eleventy, or Jekyll) into your current repo by default, inject the correct base path for the target repo, wire the official GitHub Actions Pages deploy workflow, set the repo's Website link, and explain how to enable Pages.

plugins.name: create-skill
plugins.description: Create and register a complete portable agent skill with instructions, tests, Vally evals, catalog metadata, and optional validated thumbnail art.

plugins.name: create-skills-repo
plugins.description: Create or safely upgrade a cross-agent skills marketplace repository with manifests, Vally, secure CI, Dependabot, a starter skill, and an optional GitHub Pages catalog.

plugins.name: naming-is-hard
plugins.description: Interactive naming assistant: profile what you're building, explore on-brief candidate names while a preference model learns your taste, then validate against real availability (domains via DNS + RDAP, GitHub, npm/PyPI/crates/RubyGems/NuGet, social handles) plus a trademark and existing-business screen. Every finalist rolls up to one of three verdicts: Deal Breaker, It's Complicated, or Perfect Match.

plugins.name: repo-ready
plugins.description: Scaffold and maintain standard community health files for any GitHub repository. Two modes: init (interview, detect stack, scaffold everything) and update (scan for gaps, suggest additions). Generates .gitignore, .gitattributes, LICENSE, README, CONTRIBUTING, CODE_OF_CONDUCT, SECURITY, issue/PR templates, dependabot, CI workflows, CODEOWNERS, .editorconfig, and more.

plugins.name: eli5
plugins.description: Explain the subject already in context using plain language, a useful analogy, the proper grown-up terms, and an honest note about where the analogy stops working.

plugins.name: dns-doctor
plugins.description: Audit DNS and domain health with explicit evidence coverage across delegation, records, DNSSEC, CAA, web routing, TLS, CDN behavior, mail authentication, takeover exposure, TTLs, and zone hygiene, then apply exact provider changes only after explicit user approval.

plugins.name: deps-doctor
plugins.description: Audit, update, and secure dependencies across npm, pnpm, Yarn, pip, Pipenv, Poetry, uv, Go, Cargo, Bundler, Composer, NuGet, Maven, Gradle, Swift, pub, and Hex, plus Docker base images, GitHub Actions, Terraform, and dev container features. Finds outdated, unused, and undeclared packages, withholds releases too new to have been vetted, ranks vulnerabilities by exploitation evidence, screens supply-chain risk, and fixes breaking changes forward without ever opening an empty pull request.

plugins.name: git-tidy
plugins.description: Comprehensive git repository hygiene in one pass across local and remote branches, worktrees, stashes, tags, remotes, merge and rebase artifacts, ignored-but-tracked files, large history blobs, and maintenance health. Classifies every finding by confidence (safe, review, keep), keeps protected branches and release tags off the deletion list, holds large-blob findings to report-only, and deletes nothing without explicit user approval.
